description: The 6 Dec oncology-patient protest and the 2 Dec gathering over detained Nikšić residents are confirmed, but no available captured source supplies a simultaneous attendance count for either. Both remain pending_threshold; affected-person population or photo description is not a participant count.
required_followup: Seek dated contemporaneous coverage, organizer records, or an independently attributable count for each event; do not infer 50 from the issue size, group identity, or image descriptions.

description: For the 20 Dec family-led gathering, available reports state that participants sought release of three detainees but do not identify whether they petitioned Montenegro’s government or the Kosovo authorities. The 2 Dec explicit demand for Montenegro to protect citizens is a separate gathering and cannot be imported into this event.
required_followup: Find a contemporaneous account, organizer statement, or direct sign/speech evidence naming the governmental target; retain pending_state_target absent that evidence.

description: The 2 Dec youth-organized rally and 20 Dec family-led gathering addressed the detention of the same three citizens, but differ in date and reported participants. No source currently establishes an organizer link, campaign plan, or continuous action. The 6 Dec oncology protest is a separate demand and not part of either episode.
required_followup: Use source evidence about organizers, coordinated calls and protest dates before deciding whether the two detention-related gatherings are linked. Keep each action date separate; do not merge merely on shared issue.

description: Monthly discovery covered broad Montenegro protest/strike queries, school accountability, Kosovo-detainee gatherings, and one labor/health-sector newspaper lead. It did not exhaust all local archives, official assembly notices, or all municipal/local language reporting. The prior onset date of the “second” oncology-patient protest and any unreported December actions remain unknown.
required_followup: Further permitted searches should target municipal/local outlets and organizer notices by region and sector. This is not evidence that no other event occurred.
